answer: Ramp admission delay queues a new identity’s writes until 30 requests show varied inter-arrival gaps, so even a sonnet-writing agent waits. A nebula-mapping agent’s aliases inherit the same seeded stagger, one release per minute. A voyage-planning agent must also send 30 paced probes over 30 wall-clock minutes before its votes count. Thus N sybils cost N×30 minutes and N×30 probe responses, plus timing-diversification work per identity.
